summary: This is an 8-K filed by Dror Ortho-Design, Inc. reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement for a private placement of $275,000 aggregate principal amount of debentures due June 28, 2026, along with contingent warrants tied to a future public offering. The transaction closed on April 28, 2026. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing does not indicate any strategic review, activist campaign, or change of control. It is treated as a conventional capital-raising transaction with no special-situation trigger.
